subject: Q2 pipeline category realignment + commitment criteria bootcamp

Cc: 
Date: 2026-03-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning pipeline categories (Commit/Best Case/Pipeline) + bootcamp invite

Team —

Quick heads up from RevOps: Finance has finalized a small but important set of clarifications to our forecast categories. The intent is to tighten the criteria so commits roll forward with higher confidence and Best Case stays useful for upside. The three core updates are attached (pipeline-defs-v2.pdf):

- Commit: active legal/PO or final internal approval + expected close date within quarter OR consistent sustained buyer engagement with no open blockers
- Best Case: legitimate upside that requires a specific, identified dependency (PO, budget review, leadership sign-off) that is likely but not guaranteed
- Pipeline / Early Pipeline: exploratory conversations and discovery; no binding commitment expected

Why this matters: last quarter we saw a ~9% over-commit due to ambiguous ‘commit’ tagging. These definitions are intentionally more prescriptive (see page 2 of the PDF) and include a short checklist for AE reviews.

Request: please review the attached defs and confirm any edge cases by EOD Monday. We’re running a 45-minute bootcamp to walk through examples and calibration exercises on Wednesday (calendar link included in a follow-up). Ask: bring 2 live deals from your book to discuss — one candidate commit and one candidate best-case.

Attachments: pipeline-defs-v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
